data.name: Khydaarun
data.gender_notes: Khydaarun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Servant of the Almighty, one who follows the path of Allah. The name Khydaarun carries the meaning “Follower of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khydaarun usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who strive to remain close to Allah, following His path and seeking His guidance
data.etymology: Khydaarun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khydaarun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: خيدارون
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من خضراء، يعني الشخص الذي يملك صفات الخضرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خيدارون مشتق من الجذر العربي 'خ-ض-ر' الذي يحمل معاني الخضرة والنمو والحياة. في اللغة العربية، يرتبط هذا الاسم بالطبيعة والخصوبة. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنبياء: 'وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ الَّذِينَ لَوْلَاؤُوا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ'، الآية ٣٦، وَ 'خَضِرٍ' في سورة الكهف الآية ٦٦. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لما له من دلالات روحية و دينية

in_urdu.name: خیدارون
in_urdu.meaning: خضراء سے مشتق، یعنی جس کی صفات خضرت ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام خیدارون عربی جڑ 'خ-ض-ر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کے معنی خضرت، نمو اور زندگی کے ہیں۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اسلامی ناموں کی فہرست میں شامل ہے جس کے معنی روحانی ترقی اور دینی اہمیت کے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ اس کا استعمال ثقافت اور روایت کا حصہ ہے

in_hindi.name: ख़ैदारुन
in_hindi.meaning: हरियाली से जुड़ा, ख़ुसboo से भरपूर
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम ख़ैदारुन अरबी मूल 'ख-ض-र' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है हरियाली, वृद्धि और जीवन। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अपनी आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्ता के लिए जाना जाता है। यह नाम प्राकृतिक और आध्यात्मिक विकास की भावना को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: خیدارون
in_pashto.meaning: د خضراء څخه مشتق شوی، د ژوند معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د خیدارون نوم د عربي ريښې 'خ-ض-ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د خضراء، وده، او ژوند معنی لري. په پښتني کلتور کې، دا نوم د اسلامي نومونو برخه ده چې روحاني او ديني ارزښتونه لري

in_english.name: Khydaarun
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root 'خ-ض-ر', signifying growth and life
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khydaarun originates from the Arabic root 'خ-ض-ر' (kha-dha-rah), which conveys meanings of greenery, growth, and life. This root is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Kahf, verse 66, and Surah Al-Anbiya, verse 36, symbolizing spiritual growth and renewal. In Islamic tradition, the name Khydaarun represents a person with spiritual and moral growth, harmony with nature, and a strong connection to faith. The name is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and significance

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khydaarun" in the Islamic tradition carries a strong cultural significance as it signifies being a devoted servant of Allah. This name is reminiscent of the brotherhood of all Muslims, who often refer to each other as "Akh" (brother), "Ustadh" (teacher), or "Khadim" (servant). The name emphasizes the communal bond between Muslims in their shared commitment to the faith and their obedience to Allah. It is a name that inspires respect and recognition for the servant-like attitude that every Muslim strives to cultivate within themselves, as they seek to fulfill their duties to Allah and to their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Khydaarun" holds a profound spiritual significance, as it highlights the importance of being a servant of Allah and the ultimate goal of human existence - to worship and submit to Allah. By adopting the name "Khadim," or servant, one reminds themselves of this critical spiritual purpose. The name also evokes the concept of devotion and humility, as a servant is expected to be obedient and devoted to their master. In the context of Islamic teachings, the servant's master is, of course, Allah. Embracing the name "Khydaarun" is a constant reminder to live a life that is pleasing to Allah and to fulfill the religious obligations that bring one closer to Him. The spiritual significance of this name underscores the importance of living a life that is centered on the worship of Allah and the realization of the Divine presence in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Follower of God" symbolizes Servant of the Almighty, one who follows the path of Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Khydaarun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of follower of god.

historical_references.context: He was a prominent figure in early Islamic history and is mentioned in various historical sources.
